title: Has today been a blur for anyone?
content: The past few nights as usual I feel like I am having very intense mall world dreams but of course my memory is blocked . Every time I try to think back on what was happening or even scrape anything together I get nothing it’s all blurry in my mind , it’s there I know it’s there I can feel it and see it but at the same time I can not . I’ve been in kinda a stalemate with my mood / life / emotions for as long as I could remember. Everything would just seem to be floating by. This past 3-5 days for the first time I have felt alive, I have felt I could think, I felt I was not trapped under other’s decisions. I was feeling free of what ever mental trap I was under , today was a bad day. Everything seems to feel the same now and I have a feeling it was because of what happened in mall world. As soon as even your subconscious mind starts putting pieces together for you and trying to get you out of the knot you are in you are always swept back.
